verdict.rationale: Lever's own Data API lets you create and list records without the UI, using OAuth. A separate integrator sandbox environment supports non-interactive, scripted use. Nothing documents a CLI, CI recipes, or headless or service-account execution aimed at pipelines, and sandbox access is partner-gated. Missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, CI/pipeline documentation, self-serve non-interactive service credentials, hands-on corroboration of automated CI usage.
